combinations.readout: capsaicin-induced ablation of GFP-positive axons in vitro
combinations.magnitude: about 60% of axons affected by capsaicin vs 30% with 1 uM paclitaxel
combinations.model: microfluidic culture of TRPV1-GFP DRG neurons
combinations.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with paclitaxel slowed down the rate and reduced the extent of degeneration in a concentration-dependent manner, and only 30% of GFP-positive axons were affected by capsaicin on coapplication with 1 µM paclitaxel.

combinations.readout: free tubulin in dissociated sensory neurons
combinations.magnitude: paclitaxel suppressed the capsaicin-induced increase in free tubulin
combinations.evidence_quote: This effect was suppressed by pretreatment with paclitaxel (1 µM), which is consistent with its inhibitory effects on capsaicin-induced ablation of the nerve fiber.

combinations.readout: intraepidermal nerve fiber number in hind paw skin
combinations.magnitude: fiber number significantly greater with capsaicin plus paclitaxel than capsaicin plus vehicle
combinations.model: TRPV1-GFP mice, hind paw capsaicin ablation
combinations.evidence_quote: The number of intraepidermal fibers in the skin injected with capsaicin plus paclitaxel was significantly greater than the number in the skin injected with capsaicin plus vehicle.

combinations.magnitude: paclitaxel prevented the capsaicin-induced rise in mechanical threshold
combinations.evidence_quote: By contrast, coadministration of capsaicin with paclitaxel did not increase the mechanical threshold and effectively prevented capsaicin-induced analgesia.

combinations.readout: CGRP+ afferent terminal density in facial skin (whole-mount)
combinations.magnitude: CGRP+ terminals significantly greater with capsaicin plus paclitaxel than capsaicin plus vehicle
combinations.evidence_quote: CGRP+ afferent terminals were significantly greater in the CCI/Cap/Pac group compared with the CCI/Cap/Veh group (Figs. 5B and C).

combinations.readout: capsaicin-induced axonal ablation (paclitaxel plus calpain inhibitor)
combinations.magnitude: simultaneous inhibition did not show substantial additivity
combinations.model: microfluidic culture of TRPV1-GFP DRG neurons
combinations.evidence_quote: Individual inhibition of calpains and microtubule depolymerization robustly prevented capsaicin-induced ablation, and simultaneous inhibition did not show substantial additivity, suggesting microtubule depolymerization may be downstream of calpain activation.

combinations.magnitude: same extent of analgesia in WT and S801A mice
combinations.evidence_quote: Capsaicin injection to the facial skin produced the same extent of analgesia in WT and TRPV1 S801A mice, suggesting that TRPV1 S801 phosphorylation does not influence capsaicin-induced analgesia.
